'''Huldamun''' was a relatively prosperous [[Factory world/Legends|industrial planet]] located in the [[Huldamun system/Legends|Huldamun system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Vaschean Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Arkanis system/Legends|Arkanis]] and [[Vasch system/Legends|Vasch systems]]. Huldamun was a part of the informal grouping of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] known as the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Regency Worlds]], and it chiefly exported [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huldamun was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA" />
